title: The Strange Reality of What Lies Inside Jupiter
description: Explore the layers of the solar system's largest planet where gas turns into liquid metal and the core slowly melts away.

shots.narration: The clouds seen by the Juno spacecraft are only the top layer of this world. There is no solid ground here, only a deep atmosphere that never ends.
Below the clouds, the gas is squeezed into liquid hydrogen. Deeper still, the intense pressure turns this liquid into a form of metal that conducts electricity like wire.
The core is hotter than the surface of the Sun. Instead of a solid stone, this center is slowly dissolving into the metallic hydrogen that surrounds it on all sides.
